page.overview:
Who is Bugut?

When spoken to, Bugut frequently makes reference to his old age. In his youth, he was a mountain-climber, particularly on the , where he used the Stable as a base.

Bugut enjoys mornings and bright days. When he travels during the night, he'll comment that he's awake past his bedtime. He also shows an interest in the near Kakariko Village, recommending prepare before he investigates it.

While in direct proximity to the , remarks upon the look in 's eyes, claiming that he knows that won't stay there for long due to the call for adventure. While resting inside, he talks about how is a good shopping destination due to its food and fashion.

When Link saves Bugut from enemies, he will be grateful. He may also comment that Link is tough despite his youth. He'll give him meals as a reward.
